verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents error-handling branches, dedicated error workflows, or alerts on failed runs. Organization outbound webhooks notify external systems 'when something happens in your organization', but the evidence never says run failures are among those events. The Performance sidebar is general agent monitoring, not failure notification, so both count only as adjacent features.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails
